prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1303; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Insured reports a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured states they were turning left on a green light when the other vehicle proceeded straight through. Photos of both vehicles requested and received. Police report number pending.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's representing attorney's office. Attorney confirmed representation and requested that all further contact go through counsel. Claimant reports knee injury from the impact and is pursuing medical evaluation. Written notice of representation placed in file.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene diagram and witness statement. Witness supports insured's account that the opposing vehicle was passing through the intersection against a signal. Liability position under review pending video footage from nearby business.

Entry 4: Received medical records summary from claimant's attorney. Records indicate knee injury with ongoing treatment and follow-up scheduled. Requested authorization forms and prior medical history through counsel. Reserve adjusted to reflect injury claim.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant's attorney regarding settlement posture. Attorney indicated demand package will follow once treatment concludes. Advised that liability investigation is still open. File remains active and will be reviewed at next scheduled checkpoint.
